answer: One concrete mechanism: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The hollow of work and the ledge of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a quartz to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
